armySpecialRules.name: DUCK & WEAVE
armySpecialRules.description: Enemies attacking Infantry models with this special rule suffer -1 To Hit in close combat.

armySpecialRules.name: HOMESTEADERS
armySpecialRules.description: Units with this special rule are Stubborn so long as they are at least partially within their Deployment Zone.

armySpecialRules.name: NATURAL RESISTANCE
armySpecialRules.description: When a Halfling army attempts to dispel, they have a +1 bonus to all dispel attempts.

armySpecialRules.name: PIGGYBACK RIDERS
armySpecialRules.description: Models with this upgrade gain the Fight in Extra Ranks (1) special rule.

armySpecialRules.name: TRINKETS
armySpecialRules.description: Models with this special rule may take up two Talismans and/or Enchanted Items rather than just one of each.

magicItems.name: THE REAPER SCYTHE
magicItems.description: The Reaper Scythe grants the wielder the Killing Blow rule, as well as one extra attack for each enemy infantry model in base contact.

magicItems.name: TIMBER AXE OF JONNO THE SLICK
magicItems.description: The wielder treats their Strength to be equal to that of their Initiative in close combat.

magicItems.name: BOW OF APPLE OAK
magicItems.description:
This weapon has the following profile:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
16/24" | 4 | March & Shoot, Multiple Shots (4)

magicItems.name: THE EPIC FLAIL
magicItems.description: The wielder of this weapon may re-roll failed rolls To Hit and To Wound. However, they must always pursue a fleeing enemy.

magicItems.name: GILDED LADLE
magicItems.description: The wielder gains +1 Strength. In your Magic Phase, the Master Chef may attempt to heal one Wound lost previously during the game on themselves or another friendly Character in base contact. Roll a D6; on a 4+ the Wound is restored.

magicItems.name: KNEECAPPING HAMMER
magicItems.description: All attacks made with this weapon may re-roll to Wound. In addition, if a 6 is rolled on the To Wound roll, the target may not Attack this round of close combat.

magicItems.name: SPEAR OF JUSTICE
magicItems.description: A model carrying the Spear of Justice gains +1 to their Weapon Skill, Strength and Initiative characteristics.

magicItems.name: OLD HOPEFUL
magicItems.description: Any shots fired with this weapon have the Heroic Killing Blow rule.

magicItems.name: THE BLADDERWHACK
magicItems.description: Roll a D6 at start of each close combat the Bladderwhack is used. On a 6, all attacks made by it will be resolved at Strength 10 with the Multiple Wounds (D6) special rule.

magicItems.name: BOW OF CORNGOLD
magicItems.description: The Bow of Corngold gives the wielder the Sniper special rule.

magicItems.name: TERRY'S EYE-POKING STICK
magicItems.description: On the To Hit roll of a 6, the target is reduced to Weapon Skill 1 for the duration of the close combat round.

magicItems.name: WAR CLUB OF ELDER BANDO
magicItems.description: Attacks made with this weapon have the Multiple Wounds (D3) special rule.

magicItems.name: THE WHEATSHIELD
magicItems.description: The Wheatshield confers the Regeneration (5+) special rule to its wielder. If the bearer is reduced to his final Wound, this is increased to Regeneration (3+) instead as long as he remains at 1 Wound.

magicItems.name: TRICKSTER'S ARMOUR
magicItems.description: Whenever an enemy model rolls a natural 6 To Hit or To Wound against the wearer of this armour, the Hit/Wound is ignored.

magicItems.name: THE OAKGNARL
magicItems.description: The Oakgnarl confers +1 Toughness upon the wearer. However, the wearer also becomes Flammable.

magicItems.name: TRAILBLAZER'S HAUBERK
magicItems.description: The wearer of this armour gains the Scouts and Strider special rule.

magicItems.name: LARGO'S LEATHER JERKIN
magicItems.description: All enemy attacks targeting the wearer must re-roll successful rolls To Wound.

magicItems.name: COOKING POT HELM
magicItems.description: The Cooking Pot Helm confers a 6+ armour save. In addition, the wearer gains the Immunity (Killing Blow) special rule.

magicItems.name: PARRYING POT LID
magicItems.description: The wielder may re-roll failed Parry saves.

magicItems.name: LUCKY'S COLLAR
magicItems.description: The wearer gains a Magical Ward (2+). However, every time the wearer successfully passes his Ward save, one friendly model in base contact immediately suffers the Wound instead, with no saves of any kind allowed. If there are no eligible models to redirect the Wound onto, then this save may not be taken.

magicItems.name: RABBIT'S FOOT
magicItems.description: The bearer can only be Hit on the roll of a 6 in close combat. This has no effect on Attacks that Hit automatically.

magicItems.name: AMULET OF HOKERY-POKERY
magicItems.description: When an enemy spell has been cast, a model with this item can use it instead of attempting to dispel the spell by using dispel dice. This gives them 6 free dispel dice to attempt to dispel the spell, which cannot be combined with any other dispel dice (Ultimate Power applies as normal). This may also be used to dispel spells that are Remains in Play. After it has been used, roll a D6. On a 4+, you may use the item again as described above.

magicItems.name: ESMERALDA'S LOCKET
magicItems.description: This item may be used when attempting to dispel an enemy spell. The first time it is used, you may add +3 Dispel dice to the dispel roll. The second time you may add +2 dice. The third time you may add +1 dice. After it has been used three times during the battle, the item has run out of power and has no further effect.

magicItems.name: RING OF INVISIBILITY
magicItems.description: The wearer may use this item at the start of any of their turns. Once they do so, they cannot be directly targeted by any kind of attack until the start of their next turn. However, no friendly unit may use their Leadership during this time.

magicItems.name: BLACK PEPPER SPRAY
magicItems.description: All enemy models in base contact with the bearer of the black pepper spray must re-roll all successful rolls to Hit in the first round of close combat.

magicItems.name: SAM'S SPELLPOUCH
magicItems.description: Whenever an enemy spell is cast at the bearer or any unit they are with, roll a D6. On a 6, the spell is automatically dispelled.

magicItems.name: DRAGONBANE GEM
magicItems.description: The bearer gains the Immunity (Flaming Attacks) special rule.

magicItems.name: LUCKY CHARM
magicItems.description: The Halfling player may reroll any dice roll directly affecting the bearer of the Lucky Charm.

magicItems.name: PIDGEON PLUCKER PENDANT
magicItems.description: This item grants the bearer a Magical Ward (4+) against Wounds caused in close combat by models that have the Fly special rule.

magicItems.name: WIZARDING HAT
magicItems.description: The wearer is treated as being a Level 2 Wizard who can use a randomly chosen spell lore from any of the Winds of Magic from the Warhammer Rulebook at the start of the game. However, they also have the Stupidity special rule. Note that they may not choose any Arcane Items.

magicItems.name: OLORIN THE GREY'S KNICKKNACK
magicItems.description: This item contains both The Enfeebling Foe and The Withering spells from the Lore of Shadows. However, you may only attempt to cast one of these spells once per Magic phase.

magicItems.name: TERRANCE CHUBBLY'S ENCHANTED ARROWS
magicItems.description:
At the start of the game, roll a D6 and consult the table below to see what effect the Magic Arrows have on any shortbows carried by the bearer and any unit they are with the remainder of the game:
D6 | Result
1 | All shots gain the Armour Piercing (1) special rule.
2 | Any enemy unit suffering 1 or more casualties must take a Panic test.
3 | The unit ignores all Shooting Modifiers that are not caused by magic items or spells.
4 | The unit may fire Multiple Shots even if they have marched this turn.
5 | All shots gain the Poisoned Attacks special rule.
6 | You may choose any one of the results above.

magicItems.name: THE BEEFUP BAUBLE
magicItems.description:
The bearer may use this item at the start of each round of close combat they are involved in. Roll a D6 and consult the chart below to see what effect it has:
D6 | Result
1 | The bearer immediately suffers a wound, with no saves of any kind allowed.
2-3 | No effect.
4 | The bearer gains +1 Weapon Skill, Initiative and Attack.
5 | The bearer gains +1 Strength and +1 Toughness.
6 | The bearer immediately makes a Strength 5 Breath Weapon attack with the Ignores Armour Saves special rule and then loses any statistics bonuses previously gained from this item.

magicItems.name: CLOAK OF ILLUSION
magicItems.description: This is an augment spell that targets the wearer and any unit they are with. All enemy missile attacks must re-roll successful rolls to Hit against this unit until the start of your next Magic phase.

magicItems.name: DARCIE'S MAGICAL THINGIMABOB
magicItems.description:
The Thingimabob contains the Signature spell from one of the eight Winds of Magic in the Warhammer Rulebook. Roll a D6 at the start of the game and consult the table below to see which:
D6 | Result
1 | Your opponent chooses the Lore of Magic.
2-5 | Randomly determine the Lore of Magic.
6 | You may choose the Lore of Magic.

magicItems.name: THE EMERALD LODE
magicItems.description: This is a hex spell with a range of 24". The target unit cannot use of any kind of invulnerable save until the start of your next Magic phase.

magicItems.name: JADE SICKLE
magicItems.description: This item contains the Regrowth spell from the Lore of Life.

magicItems.name: FOUR-LEAF CLOVER
magicItems.description: The wearer may re-roll 1's To Hit and To Wound in close combat and with missile attacks.

magicItems.name: ENCHANTED HONING STEEL
magicItems.description: The bearer and any unit they are with gains the Armour Piercing (1) special rule.

magicItems.name: COCKERELL SCROLL
magicItems.description: Bound Spell (Level 1, cast on 5+). This is a hex spell with a range of 24" that targets a single character, even if within a unit. Until the start of your next Magic phase, the target has all their characteristics reduced to 1 and may not channel, cast spells, use any equipment, magic items or special rules they might have.

magicItems.name: DIMMINU'S LOCKPICK
magicItems.description: The bearer may roll 2D6 on the Light-fingered chart and choose the highest result.

magicItems.name: OUTLANDISH UNIFORM
magicItems.description: The model gains the Inspiring Presence (6) special rule. However, they may never refuse a challenge.

magicItems.name: EVERLASTING SCRUMPING BASKET
magicItems.description: The bearer may take an additional 50 points of Magic Items.

magicItems.name: THE GLOVE OF SNEAKY PINCHING
magicItems.description: If the wearer of this glove is fighting in a challenge, their opponent must take an Initiative test at the start of each close combat phase. If failed, they may only use their hand weapon this round.

magicItems.name: HORN OF RIBALD TOMFOOLERY
magicItems.description: This item may be used as a charge reaction by the bearer. When used, the bearer and any unit they are with gain the Feigned Flight (see Fast Cavalry/Skirmishers) and Immunity (Psychology) special rules for the duration of the turn.

magicItems.name: STANDARD OF THE MOOT
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard and all friendly units within 12" have the Cold-blooded special rule when taking Break tests.

magicItems.name: SPELLBINDING STANDARD
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard generate +1 Dispel dice for every point of rank bonus they currently have.

magicItems.name: HONEYCOMB BANNER
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard gains +1 Strength and the Frenzy special rule.

magicItems.name: THE BANNER OF THE JOLLY HALFLING
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard gains +1 to its Toughness and the Stupidity special rule.

magicItems.name: MIDSUMMER POLE
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard gains the Regeneration (6+) special rule.

magicItems.name: PENNANT OF THE HOPPING HORSE
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard may re- roll 1's for their Movement distance when charging and pursuing.

magicItems.name: WASHING LINE
magicItems.description: Roll a D6 at the start of every round of close combat after the first. On a 4+, all Housewives in the unit may re-roll failed To Hit rolls this round as well.

magicItems.name: FLAMING PINWHEEL
magicItems.description: Both the unit carrying this standard and any units in base contact must re-roll successful rolls To Hit in the first round of close combat.

magicItems.name: SCARECROW BANNER
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard causes Terror in models with the Fly special rule.
